expand.title: So / Such ... that ... 如此…以至于…
lines: such 和so 都可以用于表示程度，但 so 只能作副词和连词，such 则是形容词，因此 so 通常位于形容词、副词之前，而 such 只能位于名词之前。 so ... that.... / such ... that ... 结果状语从句，是一个因果关系。一旦有名词, 就认为形容词修饰的是名词, 前面的词也修饰的是名词，如果名词是可数名词单数才要加a 和an, 反过来如果是可数名词单数, 前面一定要加 a 或 an 。 如果有几个以上的形容词共同修饰一个名词的时候, 冠词放在第一位, 这句话中冠词不放在第一位, 说明 “a” 与 “boy” 有关系, “lazy” 从意思上与 “boy” 有关系, 但从强调点上与 “boy” 没关系, 它的强调点在 “lazy” 上。
so + adj./adv. + that… such + (a, an) n. + that…

The story is so interesting that (所以) I want to share it with you. I am so tired that (所以) I want to sleep for an entire day. The thieves ran away so quickly that I didn't have time to call the police. The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water . It was so cold that no one went out. I’ve never read such (如此) an interesting book. It is such an interesting story that (所以) I want to share it with you. （尝试拆分成2句） It is such a heavy box that I cannot carry it. The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag .
such 像这一类的 so + many, much, little, few

He often talks about such things. You should not speak to such people. He is such a lazy boy. There is such a little bird that I can't see it.(little + 可数名词=“小”) There is so little time left that we must hurry. (little + 不可数名词=“少许、一点”) He is a boy so lazy.
